Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 36: the slip of [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2)#Source formats|Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.”), word for word the text of [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source SHA-256: <code>c63bf528513446184251b17042bb3992227dc4906436348ed7fe1c38b9df3840</code>. Crop rectangle in PDF points: <code>[214, 261, 398, 349]</code>, rendered at 200 dpi (11 November 2026, batch R8-B3).
